timeline.summary: Eveready Industries commissioned India's only operating alkaline battery facility in Jammu with an investment of ₹200 Cr.
Eveready Industries India Limited rescheduled its Q4 FY26 Earnings Conference Call from May 1, 2026, 4:30 PM IST to April 30, 2026, 5:30 PM IST per Regulation 30 of SEBI.
Eveready Industries reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹327.23 Cr and commissioned its Jammu alkaline battery plant.
Eveready Industries held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, detailing the Jammu plant commissioning and debt reduction plans.
Eveready Industries issued a communication to shareholders detailing tax deduction procedures on the recommended FY25-26 dividend.
Eveready Industries disclosed a court order from Patiala House Courts estimating damages payable to UCO Bank at ₹7.11 Cr.
Eveready Industries obtained an interim stay from the Delhi High Court against the Patiala House Court order regarding the UCO Bank building.
Eveready Industries disclosed a GST demand order of ₹0.13 Cr due to a truck seizure from a typographical error in the E-Way Bill.
Puran Associates Private Limited, as promoter, declared no encumbrance on 27,891,360 Eveready Industries India Ltd shares by March 31, 2026.
Eveready Industries commenced commercial production at its alkaline battery manufacturing facility in Jammu.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹428.24 Cr (+10.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.92 Cr (against a loss of ₹7.91 Cr a year earlier).
Eveready presented its Q2FY27 investor update highlighting 10.7% YoY consolidated revenue growth to ₹428.2 Cr and PAT of ₹31.9 Cr.
Eveready Industries approved the grant of 48,000 stock options under ESOP 2026.
